newsitem.title: CHINA: China Strategic places 132 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: China Strategic places 132 mln shares.

text.p: China Strategic Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it would privately place 132 million new shares, or 16.63 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$3.50 each.
The company said the new shares would be placed to private individual or institutional investors.
A portion of the net proceeds of HK$460 million will be used to finance the conditional underwriting of a proposed rights issue of 1.44 billion new shares by Siu-Fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd, it said.
The balance will be used for working capital.
The stake of China Strategic's controlling shareholder and chairman Oei Hong Leong will be diluted to 35.70 percent from 42.82 percent on completion of the deal.
China Strategic has said it would underwrite a proposed rights issue of Siu-Fung Ceramics' new share which might result in it taking control of the firm.
Shares of China Strategic were up HK$0.25 at HK$4.15 in late morning.
